title: Nisipos, no irrigation, Oltenia sands, mid-September
rationale: Soil exclusions as in the irrigated Dăbuleni case (nisipos in unsuitable_classes for wheat, barley and rapeseed). Without irrigation the drought lever applies: secara has drought_tolerance ridicata, triticale medie, and this brief is the driest of the six — 10.8 mm of forecast rain over 16 days, 0 mm on day 0, a +3.8 °C last-month temperature anomaly, -8.3 mm precipitation anomaly, soil moisture 0.114 m³/m³ (lowest in the set) and 2 drought-flagged years in 10.
